note: M33 A: the Dawn of the Reign. Five places, two or three short chains each, each teaching one system with what already exists. A step is done when its `done` test holds; `setup` runs when the step begins, `after` days late if it says so. Each chain pays its reward; a place whose chains are all done returns to full prosperity (its founding prosperity plus fullBonus, at most fullCap). The places start run down by startDrop. Steps: repair (a works at condition repairedAt or more), threat (the threat the step raised is gone), calm (the town's tension at or below `below` for `days`), deal (a trade deal with `realm`), dilemma (the step's dilemma answered), law (any of `laws` signed), endow (a faith endowed at the town), company (a company stationed at the town), defence (garrison and companies there at least `min` men), unrest (the town's unrest at or below `below`).

vizima.line: The capital is tired. Its manor houses stand empty, the lake shore belongs to drowners, and the Temple Quarter simmers.

steps.text: The Old Manor in the merchants' quarter has stood empty since the striga. Its roof is in and the quarter rots around it. Send masons.
Drowners have crept up out of the reeds by the lake. The fishermen will not go out. Send a company to clear them.
With the drowners gone, the boats can go out again. Put hands to the fishing: see that Vizima's harbour is manned.
Humans and non-humans live packed together in the Temple Quarter, and the tavern talk is ugly. Keep the town's tension at 25 or below for a month: a charter, a garrison, full bellies.

maribor.line: Maribor lives by trade, and its trade has gone quiet.

steps.text: Dwarven traders used to come down the Mahakam road. Strike a trade deal with Mahakam, and they will come again.
The masters of the mint and the town's moneychangers are at each other's throats. Hear them out at court.
Bandits sit on the eastern road and take a toll in blood. Clear them.

gors_velen.line: Gors Velen lies in the shadow of Thanedd, and its burghers want their rights in writing.

steps.text: Mages from Thanedd ask for privileges in the town: licences, a house, the crown's protection. Answer them at court.
Smugglers work the coast road by night, and pay the watch to look away. Send soldiers.
The burghers ask for a charter. Sign one in the Book of Laws: the Charter of the commons, or merchant charters.

ellander.line: Ellander keeps Melitele's temple, and the Fire's preachers have come to argue with her priestesses.

steps.text: Melitele's temple at Ellander needs a patron. Endow it, from the Faith screen.
Pilgrims will not walk to Ellander without an escort. Station a company there.
Fire preachers shout in Ellander's square that the priestesses harbour witches. Deal with them at court.

white_bridge.line: White Bridge holds the Pontar crossing, and both its bridge and its garrison have been let go.

steps.text: The toll bridge is half fallen into the Pontar. Mend it, and the toll comes back.
Raiders cross the Pontar where they please. Hold the crossing with 300 men or more: raise the garrison or station a company.

dawn_mint.title: The quarrel over the mint
dawn_mint.text: The masters of Maribor's mint say the moneychangers clip every coin that passes through their hands. The moneychangers say the mint strikes light. Both bring ledgers; both bring friends.

choices.label: Side with the mint: hang a moneychanger for clipping
Side with the moneychangers: the mint pays a fine
A royal assayer for both, at the crown's cost

dawn_thanedd.title: The mages of Thanedd
dawn_thanedd.text: Three mages from Thanedd ask for a house in Gors Velen, licences to practise and the crown's protection from the Fire's preachers. They offer their skills in return.

choices.label: Send them back to their island

dawn_preachers.title: Fire preachers at Ellander
dawn_preachers.text: Preachers of the Eternal Fire stand on barrels in Ellander's square and call Melitele's priestesses witches. The priestesses ask the crown to send them away; the preachers ask who will stop them.

choices.label: Let them preach, but not in the temple's shadow
Let them preach where they please
